judgment.rationale: Both are P2 Knowledge Objectives (same statement grain, same resolved Grade coordinate rank 1), but they sit in different Topic/Sub-Topic branches: 'Telling the time at exact hour, quarter past and half past' under Measurement > Time Measurements (Unit 9), and 'Use drawings to show 1/2, 1/4 and 1/8' under Numbers and Operations > Fractions (Unit 4). Their learning components share the substantive half/quarter partitioning idea (LCs 'Tell the time at quarter past / half past the hour' versus 'Use drawings to show 1/2 / 1/4'), so the fraction-drawing work and the clock-reading work are mutually reinforcing representations of halving and quartering a whole — genuine conceptual coherence rather than mere word overlap ('half', 'quarter'; the raw SFI-text overlap is only the token 'and'). However, the time objective's 'quarter past/half past' is primarily clock-face convention reading, so the evidence does not substantively establish that either objective is developmentally required for or supports success in the other at the same P2 rank; unit numbering (4 before 9) is source/local ordering, not developmental evidence. Symmetric relatesTo is therefore the supported judgment. Both endpoints carry upstream audit/merge context and truncated source evidence (24 omitted evidence items each), which limits but does not contradict this reading.
